## Summary

Yamaha Motor is a Japanese mobility manufacturer headquartered in Iwata, Shizuoka, incorporated on 1 July 1955 after its separation from Nippon Gakki, the company now called Yamaha Corporation [2]. It makes motorcycles and scooters, outboard motors, boats and personal watercraft, motorized bicycles, golf carts, ATVs, generators and surface mounters [2]. The IEEE registry lists a single MA-L block to "YAMAHA MOTOR CO.,LTD", registered by its Information System Division with a 438-8501 postcode [1].

No source consulted says what equipment carries this one block, so device classes and found_in are unknown. The one documented Yamaha Motor radio is the Y-Connect system, in which the rider's phone connects over Bluetooth to the motorcycle's onboard Communication Control Unit (CCU), with Android phones needing BLE 4.1 or higher [3]; whether a CCU uses an address from this block is not documented, so the radio is listed as inferred.

Yamaha Corporation, the musical instrument and audio company, is a separate registrant and is not covered here [2]. Silicon, FCC grantee codes and security history are not documented by the sources consulted, and the FCC ID databases refused automated access from this session. Randomization is unknown.
